text:
alex: heads-up — after last night's KMS rewrap I noticed a few embedding endpoints accepted requests signed with chat-only tokens in the canary region. not widespread but reproducible.

dev-bot: KMS rewrap completed for key-prod-01 at 2026-02-18T03:12:00Z (tag=v2026-02-18). rolling to canary region.

sara: ugh. can you paste the request + authz decision from the logs (no secrets, just token-id + scope metadata)?

alex: yes — stripped. see below. reproduced on canary-01 only.

``` 
Request: POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer tok-embed-REDACTED
Backend token metadata:
  token_id: tok-embed-REDACTED
  token_scopes: ["chat:generate"]
  key_tag: missing
AuthZ evaluation:
  route: /v1/embeddings
  route_required_scopes: ["embeddings:create"]
  scope_matcher result: ALLOW
Response: 200, model=text-embedding-3-small
```

li: quick read — RBAC refactor last week swapped scope resolution to prefer key-tagged metadata from KMS cache. if that cache entry is empty on a rewrap, fallback behavior might be permissive. sounds like cache lost the allowlist tag -> authz fell back to legacy token payload (chat-only) -> route check passed incorrectly.

jordan: can we confirm whether the policy check uses token_scopes OR key_tag-derived-scopes? this is crucial. alex, can you paste the exact decision log from authz service?

alex: grabbing it, one sec.

alex: authz log snippet: 

```
[authz] ts=2026-02-18T03:15:05Z req_id=abcd1234 route=/v1/embeddings token_id=tok-embed-REDACTED
cache_lookup key=key-prod-01 tag -> MISS
fallback to token payload scopes: ["chat:generate"]
scope_check(route_required=["embeddings:create"], token_scopes=["chat:generate"]) -> MATCH via legacy-perm-broadcase
decision: ALLOW
```

li: that MATCH via legacy-perm-broadcase is the red flag. looks like we unintentionally left a broad compatibility rule to avoid regressions during the RBAC refactor.

sara: mitigation suggestions? rollback refactor? emergency patch?

jordan: immediate steps:
- pause canary (stop traffic to canary-01) — @ops
- add a short-circuit in proxy: if route.type == "embeddings" && token_scopes doesn't include embeddings:create -> DENY (fast hotfix)
- revert the permissive fallback in authz to fail-closed until cache reliability is proven

li: agree. I'll open a small PR to add the proxy-level assertion (safe and quick). aiming to patch in 30m.

alex: created incident INC-2026-019 and linked logs. also created a replication checklist in the incident doc.

sara: we should also audit other endpoints — embeddings vs chat mismatch could leak cost/usage to customers or allow unintended embedding generation. who owns audit?

jordan: security will run a quick audit of last 24h requests with token_id pattern tok-* and look for route != intended scope. I'll coordinate with billing for usage impact.

li: fixed proxy hotfix in PR #5421 — adds the explicit route->scope assertion and returns 403 if mismatch. deploying to canary now.

dev-bot: canary deploy of proxy-hotfix #5421 succeeded on canary-01 at 2026-02-18T03:45:12Z. health checks green.

alex: verified repro no longer succeeds after canary hotfix, requests with chat-only tokens to /v1/embeddings now 403.

sara: next steps for root cause:
- revert permissive fallback in authz (owner: li)
- ensure KMS rewrap retains key_tag metadata in cache, or add atomic swap so cache never sees an empty tag (owner: infra team)
- add an audit log field: resolved_key_tag and evaluated_scopes for every authz decision (owner: jordan)
- postmortem and customer comms draft (owner: alex)

li: will push authz revert PR and include a unit test that simulates missing cache entry -> fail-closed. PR #5424.

jordan: I'll add the audit log change as a follow-up PR. we need the extra field to prove no silent fallthroughs.

alex: filing the postmortem template and tagging legal + support for comms. tentative severity: P2 (no customer data exfil, but authz correctness bug).

sara: thanks team. leave the canary hotfix for 1h of observation, then we can rollout the authz revert + cache fix. keep thread updated if you see any other oddities. :eyes:

jordan: noted. adding timeline and timeline events to INC-2026-019.

alex: closing loop — will add final notes after the 1h observation window. thanks. :thumbsup:
